layer_1_raw_immutable.rule: Never edited. Raw downloads are stored outside the repo (some are large or owner-level); the repo keeps each download’s URL, UTC time, bytes and sha256 so files can be re-fetched and checked.
paths: oahu-sales.json (repo root; Honolulu sales extract used as an input)

layer_2_normalized_observations.rule: Source values parsed to JSON with source/method/notes; no cross-source arithmetic beyond what the source defines.

layer_3_calculated_comparisons.rule: Derived by scripts in this folder from layers 1–2; rerun the script to refresh.
paths: research/buyer-origins/page_data.json (built by build.py, prep.py, locals.py, irs_20yr.py, irs_decade.py, irs_states.py, moku_index.py, rate_model.py)

layer_4_report_narrative.rule: Text and layout; every figure should trace to layer 2 or 3 via metric_catalog.json.
paths: research/buyer-origins/micro/assemble.py (inserts chapter + Why boxes, injects data)
research/archive/full-report-2026-10-09-pre-handoff/ (frozen snapshot; internal; not source of truth)
